line.a_piekarnia.text: I'm opening a forest bakery! I've baked the first rolls.

line.a_ile.text: How many rolls are on the tray? Count them, touching each one in turn.

line.a_piec.text: Five rolls! The last number tells how many there are.

line.a_rozloze.text: I'll spread them along the whole counter, to look nice.

line.a_wiecej.text: Oh, now there are more! They take up so much room!

line.a_policz.text: Bear, are there really more rolls now? Count them again, each one in turn.

line.a_dalej_piec.text: Still five! When we spread things out, there aren't more of them.

line.a_rozumiem.text: Five is five, close together or far apart. I see!

line.p_start.text: Let's practise counting to five! I have five games.

line.p_ile.text: How many rolls are there? Count them and point to the number.

line.p_taca_nie.text: Count the cookies. A long row doesn't mean more.

line.p_memory.text: Turn the cards over and find the pairs: a number and as many dots.

line.p_czwarta.text: Count from the arrow and point to the fourth roll.

line.p_czwarta_nie.text: Count from the arrow: first, second, third, fourth.

line.h_goscie.text: Five guests are coming to supper. Let's set the table!

line.h_talerze.text: Put all the plates on the table.

line.h_kubki.text: And I'll stand the cups here, close together.

line.h_po_jednym.text: Five plates and five cups. Every guest has one!

line.h_rodzice.text: When you set the table, count the plates and the cups with your parents!

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for helping in the bakery! Here is a sticker for your album, as a keepsake. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is a roll from Bear's bakery. We got it when we counted to five.

line.a_karteczka.text: Someone slipped a note under the door! There's a feather on it. It's from Owl!

line.a_karteczka_ile.text: It's an order! Owl drew how many rolls she wants, so point to each roll in the drawing, one by one.

line.a_maka.text: Just a little flour on top... Oh no! The sack fell over!

line.a_pod_maka.text: Everything is white! Wipe the flour off the counter with your finger, and we'll see what's under it.

line.a_zaniesiemy.text: Let's take them to Owl! She lives past the orchard, in a big hollow.

line.b_sad.text: What a lovely orchard! Can you hear? Somebody's chirping.

line.b_najedzony.text: The bird is full! It's chirping goodbye to us.

line.b_dalej.text: Let's go on, Owl is waiting for her rolls.

line.c_dziupla.text: This is it! Owl's hollow is high up in the tree.

line.c_sowa.text: Good afternoon! My rolls! They're for my owlets.

line.c_rozdaj.text: Owlets, come down! Give each owlet one roll.

line.c_po_jednej.text: Four owlets and four rolls. Each one has its own!

line.c_zaplace.text: I pay one coin for each roll. Count four coins onto the plate for me, my eyes are so sleepy in the daytime.

line.c_dziekuje.text: Four coins! My very first payment. Thank you!

line.c_zaproszenie.text: Tonight we celebrate the bakery's opening. Come to supper at my house!

line.c_przyjdziemy.text: We'll all come, me and my owlets!

line.p_domino.text: These are domino tiles. Which tile has five dots?

line.p_domino_nie.text: Count all the dots on this tile, one after another.

line.p_domino_ok.text: Yes, this tile has five dots!

line.p_taca_ok.text: Yes, there are five cookies here, even though they lie far apart!

line.h_w_domu.text: The bakery is open, and tonight Owl and the owlets are coming!

line.h_za_malo.text: Oh no! There are more plates than cups! There won't be enough cups!

line.h_sprawdzmy.text: Let's check! First count the cups, touching each one in turn.

line.h_teraz_talerze.text: And now count the plates on the table.

line.h_piec_talerzy.text: Five plates! As many as the cups.

line.h_kubek_na_talerz.text: Put one cup on each plate.

line.h_starczy.text: Enough for everyone! Far apart or close together, five is five.

line.h_hu.text: Shh! Somebody's hooting at the door. Count how many times.

line.h_ile_hu.text: How many times did somebody hoot? Point to the number.

line.h_ile_hu_nie.text: Listen again and count how many times somebody hoots.

line.h_piec_gosci.text: Five times! Each guest hooted once, so there are five guests.

line.h_smacznego.text: Welcome, guests! Rolls fresh from my bakery. Enjoy your meal!

line.h_udane.text: The bakery's first day was a great success!

line.h_pokaz.text: Watch how I count the plates at the table.

line.a_sa.text: There they are! The rolls were under the flour!

line.a_spakuj.text: Put four rolls into the bag. Drag them one at a time and I'll count.

line.a_za_duzo.text: That's four already! No more needed.

line.b_ptaszek_ziarno.text: It's a hungry little bird! Give it the seeds we have in the basket, and leave the pine cone.
